plugins.name: ace
plugins.description: Code Engine ACE - Intelligent pattern learning with continuous auto-search. v6.6.3: Bugfix — large traces now learn reliably. ace_after_task.py sent the ExecutionTrace to ace-cli learn via --stdin, but learn --stdin cannot read payloads larger than the ~64KB OS pipe buffer (errors 'Failed to read from stdin' + BrokenPipe) → ANY trace over ~64KB silently failed to learn (main AND subagent). Fix: new _learn_via_transcript() writes the trace to a temp file and invokes ace-cli learn --transcript (no pipe-buffer limit); temp file always unlinked. Large/complex sessions now learn — a likely contributor to under-warmed bandits, alongside v6.6.0 and v6.6.2. Requires: Claude Code >= 2.1.139, ace-cli >= 3.17.0 (@ace-sdk/core >= 2.19.0).
